integrity: Every labeled tournament through order five is exhausted. Banks sets and minimal covering sets are each computed in two independent exact ways, and every strict order-five tournament is canonicalized under all alternative relabelings.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite classification through the first Banks–minimal-covering disparity order. The order-five threshold is prior work, and no frequency formula for larger tournaments is claimed.
title: Complete five-alternative Banks–minimal-covering disparity layer
